description: 迷路时不用打开翻译软件。开口问、听懂方向、再确认一遍，三步走完。

targetChunks.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
targetChunks.note: how do I get to 是问路标准开头，后面直接接地名。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Excuse me, how do I get to the train station? — Go straight, then turn right.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——请问火车站怎么走？——直走，然后右转。

targetChunks.en: Am I going the right way?
targetChunks.note: 走了一段不确定时问。比 Is this the way 更口语。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Excuse me, am I going the right way for the museum?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——请问，去博物馆是这个方向吗？

targetChunks.note: 先问远近，再决定走路还是打车。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Is it far from here? — No, about five minutes on foot.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——离这儿远吗？——不远，走路五分钟。

targetChunks.note: within walking distance 是“步行可达”，比 Is it far 更具体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Is it within walking distance? — Yes, ten minutes or so.

targetChunks.en: How long does it take on foot?
targetChunks.note: on foot 是步行。回答常听到 It's a ten-minute walk。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — How long does it take on foot? — About fifteen minutes.

targetChunks.en: Could you show me on the map?
targetChunks.zh: 能在地图上指给我看吗？
targetChunks.note: 方向词听不懂时最有效，直接让对方点地图。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Could you show me on the map? — Sure, you're here, and it's right there.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——能在地图上指给我看吗？——可以，你在这儿，就在那里。

targetChunks.note: 美式 subway，英式 underground / tube。nearest 很关键。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Where's the nearest subway station? — Just around the corner.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——最近的地铁站在哪？——就在拐角。

targetChunks.en: Should I take the bus or the subway?
targetChunks.note: 给对方两个选项，回答通常更快、更具体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Should I take the bus or the subway? — The subway is faster at this hour.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——我该坐公交还是地铁？——这个点地铁更快。

targetChunks.note: transfer 是换乘。回答可能是 Yes, at Green Park。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Do I need to transfer? — Yes, once, at Central.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——需要换乘吗？——需要，在中央站换一次。

targetChunks.note: 大站出口多，问清楚能少绕十分钟。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Which exit should I take? — Exit B, next to the bookstore.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——我该走哪个出口？——B 口，书店旁边。

targetChunks.note: 开口求助的破冰句，对方通常会主动帮你看地图。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Sorry, I think I'm lost. Can you help me?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——不好意思，我好像迷路了。能帮我一下吗？

targetChunks.note: 问完别只说 Thanks。加一句评价，语气立刻自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Thanks, you've been really helpful. Have a good one!

roleplay.promptZh: 你在街上迷路了，想走去中央车站。先问路，再确认方向，最后问需要多久。
roleplay.promptEn: You're lost and need to get to Central Station. Ask for directions, check you heard right, and ask how long it takes.
goals: 用 How do I get to... 问路
没听清时请对方重复关键信息
确认方向并问清步行时间

script.speaker: you
script.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. How do I get to Central Station?
script.zh: 不好意思打扰一下，请问中央车站怎么走？

script.speaker: other
script.en: Sure. Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the bank.
script.zh: 好，直走两个街区，到银行左转。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Two blocks, then left at the bank?
script.zh: 抱歉我没听清。两个街区，然后银行左转？

script.speaker: other
script.en: That's right. It's about a ten-minute walk.

script.speaker: you
script.en: Is it within walking distance from here?

script.speaker: other
script.en: Yes, very close. Just keep going this way.
script.zh: 能，很近。就沿这条路一直走。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Great. Am I going the right way?

script.speaker: other
script.en: Yes, you're headed the right way.
